findings.explanation: You can be terminated by the client for any reason with 30‑day notice, and the contract does not require the client to pay for work already performed.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days prior written notice. Upon termination, the Customer shall pay the Contractor for all services performed and costs incurred up to the effective termination date.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
I hope you’re well.

- The relevant clause currently allows termination by the Customer with thirty days’ notice but does not require payment for work already performed. I propose that either party may terminate for convenience with thirty days’ written notice, and that upon termination the Customer shall pay the Contractor for all services performed and costs incurred up to the effective termination date.

Thank you for your consideration.
